name: verify_accountCashRounding_audit_columns_by_id
note: account_cash_rounding: create/write uid and date per row (mail/chatter and the record's metadata read), keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, create_uid, write_uid, create_date, write_date FROM account_cash_rounding ORDER BY id

name: verify_accountCashRounding_scalar_listing
note: account_cash_rounding: every int/string/bool column of every row as a list view reads it, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, sequence, company_id, rounding_method, strategy, active FROM account_cash_rounding ORDER BY id

name: verify_accountCashRounding_embed_fanout_by_parent
note: account_cash_rounding: per-parent count of each embedded array (account_cash_rounding_res_currency_rel, account_cash_rounding_res_partner_category_rel, account_cash_rounding_account_payment_method_line_rel) against the child-row count, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT r.id, COALESCE(e0.n, 0) AS n_rescurrencyrel, COALESCE(e1.n, 0) AS n_respartnercategoryrel, COALESCE(e2.n, 0) AS n_accountpaymentmethodlinerel FROM account_cash_rounding r LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_cash_rounding_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM account_cash_rounding_res_currency_rel GROUP BY account_cash_rounding_id) e0 ON e0.pid = r.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_cash_rounding_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM account_cash_rounding_res_partner_category_rel GROUP BY account_cash_rounding_id) e1 ON e1.pid = r.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_cash_rounding_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM account_cash_rounding_account_payment_method_line_rel GROUP BY account_cash_rounding_id) e2 ON e2.pid = r.id ORDER BY r.id
